Workflow discipline that is not code-specific — interviews, handoffs, teaching — and the invocable form of the `config/practice/conventions/` dispositions: design a module, spike an idea, implement it, review the diff.

| Skill | What it does | Origin | Trust |
|---|---|---|---|
| `app-builder` | Build complete web or mobile applications from specification through tested, documented handoff. | authored (vendor) | trusted |
| `research-software-engineering` | Investigation-first workflow for developing, refactoring or reviewing Python research software. | authored | trusted |
| `wizard` | Architect-mode development for complex features, bug fixes and multi-file refactors — TDD, phased planning, adversarial self-review. | authored (vendor) | trusted |
| `diagram-design` | Draw an editorial, brand-skinned diagram as one HTML+SVG file for a doc, brief or slide; export SVG or PNG. | imported (link) | trial |
| `personalize-context` | Interview the user so they can write USER.md and the conventions leaves in their own words. | authored | trial |
| `ponytail` | "Subtraction axis for coding: the smallest complete change, deletion over addition, and the request questioned in ultra." | imported (link) | trial |
| `ponytail-audit` | "Whole-repo one-shot report: bugs, risk, load, missing tests, speed, and what to delete, merge or split — ranked, changes nothing." | imported (link) | trial |
| `shower` | "Cold-read an artifact from a fresh, zero-context child to test whether it stands alone — a clean-room comprehension check. Hands over the contents, never the intent; it diagnoses, it does not fix." | imported (link) | trial |
